{{Top|leg}}
The '''sender''' was a special organ situated within the claw of an [[Aganof]]. Aganofs [[Aganof language|communicated]] by creating vibrations using the claw, and the sender was capable of modulating the vibrations.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
